question: DEPTH or WIDTH? The conjunction's three-way share is 88.8% at depth 2 width 128 and 48.4% at depth 3 width 64, with the difference appearing almost entirely in the softmax-times-cap pair (12.3% -> 43.5%). Those two cells differ in BOTH depth and width, so 'an extra block makes the gate optional' and 'the conjunction is weaker at narrow widths' fit the data equally well. This third cell separates them.

why_depth_3_width_128.design: with cells (depth 2, width 128), (depth 3, width 64) and (depth 3, width 128) in hand: comparing the two depth-3 cells gives the WIDTH effect at fixed depth, and comparing the two width-128 cells gives the DEPTH effect at fixed width. Both contrasts become clean.
why_depth_3_width_128.why_not_depth_2_width_64: it is faster (about half the cell time) but both families are NULL on induction there (family -0.0140, conventional -0.0149 with the cap on), so the total move could be near zero and every share is a ratio with a near-zero denominator -- an ill-conditioned decomposition. Depth 3 width 128 has a large, well-measured total move at both families (family +0.1085, conventional +0.6151 even capped), so the shares are stable. Paying the extra time to avoid dividing by nearly nothing.

design: the same 2x2x2 -- softmax vs our unnormalised two-branch product, GELU vs our ungated bilinear product, query/key cap off vs on -- three seeds per corner, all at the family's body parameter count for this cell. Three seeds from the start, per the seed-architecture bias finding.

H1_depth_is_the_driver.claim: Depth 3 width 128 resembles depth 3 width 64, not depth 2 width 128: its three-way share lands closer to 48% than to 89%, i.e. below 68% (the midpoint).
H1_depth_is_the_driver.reason: the mechanism proposed at 09:45 is specifically about depth -- the gate's job is converting a retrieved value into a logit push, and a third BLOCK supplies another site to do that. Width has no obvious analogue: making a block wider does not give you a second place in the residual stream to perform a sequential conversion.
H1_depth_is_the_driver.counter_consideration_registered_in_adva: width 128 gives 8 heads against width 64's 4, so a wider model has more room for the full conjunction to form and might look MORE like the depth-2 width-128 cell. This is the reason the confidence is 0.65 and not higher.

H2_the_pair_tracks_the_three_way.claim: Whatever the three-way share does, the softmax-times-cap pair moves in the opposite direction by a comparable amount, as it did between the first two cells (three-way -40.4 points, pair +31.2 points).

H3_the_two_non_negotiables_hold.claim: Softmax alone and cap-removal alone are each worth under 5% of the total move at this cell too, as they were at both previous cells (1.4%/-2.2% and 1.2%/-0.9%).

H4_row_normalisation_stays_dead.claim: The row-L1 diagnostic arms stay at or below +0.05 induction at this cell, as they did at both previous ones.

what_this_still_cannot_settle: Three cells is enough to separate depth from width as the driver of ONE contrast; it is not a scaling law. Nothing here licenses extrapolation to depth 4 or width 256.
